'''Haskell P. Rosenthal''' (July 8, 1940 – December 5, 2021) was an American lecturer in mathematics at the University of Texas at Austin who contributed to the study of [[functional analysis]] and [[Banach space|Banach spaces]].

== Early life and education ==
Haskell won the National Merit Scholarship when he was 16 years old. He went to MIT where he completed a [[Bachelor's degree]] in Mathematics at the age of 20.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Obituary information for Haskell Paul Rosenthal |url=https://www.moralesfuneralhome.com/obituaries/obituary-listings?obId=31269879 |access-date=2025-07-06 |website=www.moralesfuneralhome.com |language=en}}</ref> He then completed his PhD in Mathematics at [[Stanford University]], aged 24,<ref>{{Cite book |last=Rosenthal |first=Haskell P. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=lbbTCQAAQBAJ&dq=Projections+onto+Translation-Invariant+Subspaces+of+L+%5E%27P%5EG&pg=PA1 |title=Projections onto Translation-Invariant Subspaces of $L^p (G)$ |date=1966 |publisher=American Mathematical Soc. |isbn=978-0-8218-1263-1 |language=en}}</ref> under the supervision of [[Karel deLeeuw]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|13158}}</ref>

== Career and research ==
From 1966 – 1974, he was an associate professor at the Mathematics department at [[University of California, Berkeley]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Haskell Rosenthal {{!}} Department of Mathematics |url=https://math.berkeley.edu/people/past-department-members/past-senate-faculty/haskell-rosenthal |access-date=2025-04-19 |website=math.berkeley.edu}}</ref> During his time at UC Berkeley, he supervised 4 PhD students.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Haskell Rosenthal - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=13158&fChrono=1 |access-date=2025-04-19 |website=mathgenealogy.org}}</ref>

Rosenthal later joined the [[University of Texas at Austin]] in 1979, where he held the first Chair endowed in the Mathematics Department, the John T. Stuart III Centennial Professor of Mathematics.<ref>{{Cite web |title=H. Rosenthal |url=https://web.ma.utexas.edu/users/rosenthl/ |access-date=2025-04-19 |website=web.ma.utexas.edu}}</ref> He later retired with Emeritus status in 2005 and returned to UC Berkeley to became a visiting lecturer from 2013 – 2015.<ref name=":0" /> During his time at the university, he supervised 9 PhD students.<ref name=":1" />

Rosenthal published over 100 articles and manuscripts during his time at various institutions<ref>{{Cite web |title=BIBLIOGRAPHY |url=https://web.ma.utexas.edu/users/rosenthl/refs.html |access-date=2025-07-06 |website=web.ma.utexas.edu}}</ref> which were referenced an estimated 4,100 times.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Haskell Rosenthal |url=https://scholargps.com/scholars/24357214295305/haskell-rosenthal |access-date=2025-07-06 |website=scholargps.com}}</ref>
